name: Braintree Town Hall
note: Town offices, 1 JFK Memorial Drive. Emergency operations point of contact.

name: South Shore Hospital
note: Nearest full hospital to Braintree. Emergency department, 55 Fogg Road, South Weymouth.

name: Boston Medical Center
note: Level 1 trauma center, 1 Boston Medical Center Place, Boston.

name: Massachusetts General Hospital
note: Level 1 trauma center, 55 Fruit Street, Boston.

name: Blue Hills Reservation
note: 7,000-acre state reservation. High ground, trail network, Houghton's Pond. Closest large wooded area to Braintree.

name: Houghton's Pond
note: Pond in Blue Hills Reservation. Surface water — treat before drinking.

name: Ponkapoag Pond
note: Large pond, Blue Hills / Canton line. Surface water source.

name: Blue Hills Reservoir
note: Reservoir in Blue Hills. Not a public drinking supply — treat before use.

name: Neponset River
note: River through Milton and Dorchester. Surface water — treat before drinking.

name: Monatiquot River
note: River through Braintree. Surface water source.

name: Fore River
note: Tidal river, Braintree / Weymouth line. Brackish — not drinking water.

name: Chickatawbut Hill
note: Highest point in Blue Hills (~500 ft). Good vantage / repeater spot.

name: Great Blue Hill
note: Blue Hills summit with weather observatory. Highest point in the reservation.

name: Braintree Municipal Golf Course
note: Open ground east side of town. Landing / staging area.

name: Massasoit Community College
note: Canton campus. Large parking, open fields.

name: CVS Pharmacy — Washington Street
note: Pharmacy, Washington Street, Braintree Square.

name: Quincy
note: City north of Braintree. Quincy Center, Wollaston, Marina Bay.

name: Milton
note: Town northwest of Braintree, Blue Hills edge.

name: Canton
note: Town southwest of Braintree.

name: Randolph
note: Town south of Braintree.

name: Weymouth
note: Town east of Braintree, on the Fore River.

name: Holbrook
note: Town south of Braintree.

name: Stoughton
note: Town southwest of Braintree.

name: Braintree Highlands
note: Neighborhood, west Braintree.

name: Blue Hills Trailhead — Ponkapoag
note: Trailhead off Ponkapoag Trail, Canton. Access to Ponkapoag Pond and the reservation interior.

name: Blue Hills Trailhead — Houghton's Pond
note: Trailhead and parking at Houghton's Pond, Blue Hills.
